notes.title: Update 0.11.3 (INTERRUPT SPEECH)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added function to interrupt NPC's speech
[*] Changed conflicting key bindings
[*] Added new help texts
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

KEY BINDINGS
Leave Location: KEYBOARD ESC / GAMEPAD START
Toggle Notebook: KEYBOARD F1 or CTRL+N / MOUSE MIDDLE BTN / GAMEPAD LB
Toggle Mic Mute: KEYBOARD F2 or CTRL+M / GAMEPAD SELECT
Interrupt NPC: KEYBOARD F3 / GAMEPAD RB
Look Around: HOLD RIGHT MOUSE BTN or GAMEPAD RIGHT STICK

notes.title: The Notebook Update (0.9.14 Early Access)
notes.notes:
[h1]The Notebook Update[/h1]
[h2]Vaudeville 0.9.14[/h2]

A notebook to write down important information without leaving the game was one of the most requested features, so we gave it the highest priority.
We have also implemented the first two (very basic) achievements. More will come soon.
As usual, we are also improving and tweaking the characters based on inputs from the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343362/96487b165dc407ad0421b6067c2c14e1a1141afc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added notebook feature with Steam Cloud sync
[*] Implemented essential achievements
[*] Improved characters' script based on the users' feedback
[/list]
